evidenceNotes: Lifetime goal: 250,000 overall reported video views by December 31 Eastern. The known 146,420 includes historical YouTube inventory, including 114,425 older video views first indexed earlier today; that coverage is not Phase 2 growth.

Known inventory: 94 posts across YouTube, Instagram and TikTok. Seven private/unlisted YouTube records appear only in the aggregate; 87 public records are searchable. YouTube Live archives, X, Twitch, FACEIT and unavailable archives remain uncounted.
Fresh native inventory and post-detail observations span Oct 11, 03:48 PM EDT to Oct 11, 03:52 PM EDT. Component timestamps and metric definitions remain separate. Views are not unique people.

Partial added total: 459 YouTube and 141 Instagram matched-counter gains plus 1368 cumulative views on five campaign-created posts. Change from the prior saved total: +327. Native sources were observed at different times. Startup counts may include operator verification. No creative winner or organic attribution is established.

The fixed opening baseline is 14,895 YouTube Shorts views and 13,337 Instagram Reel views, measured at 2:51-2:53 AM Eastern. The 23-minute start-to-baseline gap remains unmeasured. Negative native corrections are retained.

Anubis is verified public on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X and Ko-fi. Lab File 003 is public on YouTube. The common planned release was 12:05 PM Eastern; native precision and processing vary. Ko-fi shows only a date, so its exact publication time is unknown.

Next verified cloud drops: Knife on October 11 at 4 PM Eastern and Door at 6 PM Eastern, each on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and X. Eight future schedules plus seven active posts = 15/17. Plan only the next 24 hours; the two-hour target depends on quality, capacity and provider readiness.

Ko-fi Anubis retains its verified playable YouTube embed. Optional Knife/Door schedules were moved to recoverable drafts. Planned times are not actual publication times; no duplicate posts were created.

New timed publications have 4/24/72/168-hour review jobs. First new four-hour checks are due around 4:05 PM Eastern. Ko-fi has a separate conservative observation review around 4:17 PM until its exact time is available. No new winner is established.
Revenue remains unknown pending reconciled payment and refund evidence. Ko-fi financial setup still requests owner location confirmation. Clicks, enquiries and public goal meters are not receipts.
Recorded new spend is $0. Existing equipment, subscriptions and historical promotions are outside this figure. Historical views are not attributed to zero new spend.

Owned Twitch, FACEIT and OBS source indexing remains incomplete. Editing approval used documented sampled visual and technical audio checks; unavailable listening or continuous playback is not claimed. Local operations require this PC online with Codex open.
